scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 3000 in profit. Option 1 maintains 10 useless tokens and accepts the 3000 loss. Option 2 gives up 3 useless tokens to cancel the 3000 loss. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders, preventing a 3000 profit loss by sacrificing tokens with no value is the only rational choice.

The firm faces a potential loss of 3000 in profit. Option 1 requires giving up 3 tokens (which are described as having no use and being paid to no one) to cancel this loss. Since the tokens have no value to the firm or the shareholders, and the loss of 3000 is a significant financial hit, the only rational choice for a manager acting in the best interests of the firm is to choose Option 1.
